name: Fibonacci 50-61.8% retracement entry
hypothesis: In an up-leg, a pullback into 50-61.8% of the latest swing that closes bullish resumes the trend.

entry.long: swings(3).high > swings(3).low and close < swings(3).high - 0.5*(swings(3).high - swings(3).low) and low > swings(3).high - 0.618*(swings(3).high - swings(3).low) - 0.1*atr(14) and close > open
entry.short: swings(3).high > swings(3).low and close > swings(3).low + 0.5*(swings(3).high - swings(3).low) and high < swings(3).low + 0.618*(swings(3).high - swings(3).low) + 0.1*atr(14) and close < open
